messages:
maria: Heads-up — since ~04:10 UTC we're seeing sustained write-amplification on a subset of eu-west1 scratch nodes. GPU attaches are getting delayed by 2-6m, a few pods stuck in Pending because local NVMe iowait spikes.
jonathan: Confirmed. Alerting metric: `scratch.nvme.write_amp > 6` for 30m on cohort eu-west1-b. Pod eviction/attach rate dropped ~35%.
lee: Any visible errors in dmesg or SMART?
sree: Quick grep shows repeated `blk_update_request: I/O error` on 3 hosts and scrub backlog trending up. SMART temp/err counters are normal. Likely small-block write storm + janitor overlap.
maria: Sounds like write-fractionation + concurrent scrub. Can we throttle janitor sweep cadence for the hot cohort?
jonathan: We can bump janitor to single-worker for that affinity pool immediately. Changing from 10 -> 1 should reduce concurrent small writes. I'll push a change to the janitor config.
lee: Meanwhile we should prevent more GPU attaches onto affected hosts. Suggest tainting the hot nodes to force scheduler fallback.
sree: Agreed. Quick command to cordon and taint (one-off):
```
kubectl -n kube-system patch node euw-node-123 -p '{"spec":{"unschedulable":true}}'
kubectl label node euw-node-123 arch=hot-io
kubectl taint nodes euw-node-123 scratch-io=low:NoSchedule
```
maria: @deploy-bot can we route new GPU requests to us-west1 for next 2 hours? We want minimal customer impact while we sweep.
deploy-bot: doing routing override: set `gpu.provision.region_preference = [us-west1, eu-west1]` for new allocations. ETA 30s. :white_check_mark:
jonathan: Janitor cadence change pushed (rolling config). Also dropped scrub concurrency on eu-west1 from 6 -> 2. Monitor surface.
lee: I'm running per-host kvcache eviction probe to clear prefix caches gently. That should lower write amplification of small streaming jobs.
sree: Good. For longer-term: propose adding a per-host write-merge window in the scratch write path (coalesce tiny writes for 50ms) + a hot-reservation pool to avoid concurrent janitor + user writes. I'll open an RFC.
maria: Cost/availability note — routing to us-west1 increases cross-region latency for a subset of customers (esp EU), and multi-region provisioning may bump cost by ~12% while active. Is that acceptable for 2h?
jonathan: Ops consensus: yes for an emergency mitigation. Notify support/CS if we expect >1% of attaches affected.
lee: After tainting, 4 of 5 stuck pods rescheduled within 90s. Attach queue length falling.
sree: Logging a cleanup task to reconcile orphan tempfiles and adjust janitor backoff heuristics. RFC link: https://go/repo/rfc/scratch-hot-pool (placeholder).
maria: Thanks everyone. I'll send a short incident summary to #incidents and loop in CS for potential customer messages. Will keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
